This is a second-price auction, where bidding my true value is the dominant strategy. Bidding exactly my value ($12) ensures that if I win, I pay less than my value (positive profit), and if I lose, it's because someone valued it more than me, which is the efficient outcome. Bidding higher risks negative profit if I win at a price above my value; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior history to adjust for opponent behavior, truthful bidding is optimal.
